findings.description: The edited Layout paragraph now says the types and errors sit in `types/` and `errors/`, but it still gives the old reason for the divergence. 'The task's scope was `src/core/intent*`, and the `@src` aliases ... do not exist yet. For the same reason `CONTROL_CHARS`...' still reads as justifying a layout that no longer exists, and 'For the same reason' now points back at a rationale that has been removed. The paragraph reads as stale or contradictory.

The PR rewrites the landed text of accepted ADRs 0123 (line 29) and 0126 (lines 12, 69, 72-73) in place. docs/adr/README.md:19-21 says 'Once a decision has landed, a later change appends an amendment section to it (dated, with the PR) or adds a new decision that links back through `Amends:`. It does not rewrite the landed text.' The edits only update file paths, so the harm is small. But the rule offers no exception for path corrections, so the PR should append a dated amendment note, or the author should confirm the paths-only exception is intended. This is guidance-grade ('does not'), so it is capped at nit.
